name: cambodia-pos-saas
description: Cambodia POS SaaS — Multi-tenant Point of Sale & Business Management System

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=@cambodia-pos/shared run typecheck && npm --workspace=@cambodia-pos/api run typecheck && npm --workspace=@cambodia-pos/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@cambodia-pos/shared run test && npm --workspace=@cambodia-pos/api run test && npm --workspace=@cambodia-pos/web run test
